description: This file defines the I18NLanguageAPI class, which provides CRUD API endpoints for managing internationalization (i18n) languages within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting language records, with detailed API documentation annotations.

classes.name: I18NLanguageAPI
classes.description: API class managing internationalization language entities, providing endpoints to list, retrieve, update, and delete language records, with integrated documentation annotations.
